Market today: Tech is still the focus, but macro jitters are creeping in. Geopolitical tensions and oil prices are starting to weigh, which could spill over.

Your holdings: SMCI (-18.94%) and MU (-29.47%) are still flagged for attention. SOXL (-54.06%) and SPAL (-26.04%) are also deep in the red, and with margin, these drops hurt.

Watch: Keep an eye on the leveraged ETFs like SOXL and SPAL. Their decay is a constant drag, especially when the market is choppy.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your biggest losers and the leveraged positions that are bleeding you dry.
plays: Trim SOXL and SPAL if they show further weakness; their decay is a killer on margin.
Consider trimming SMCI and MU if they don't show immediate signs of life.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
